review_scope: Exact-hash incremental successor to v0.9. Three bridge-contained public records are retained as geometry-identity context: the New Mexico State Ethics Commission Acoma/Project Jupiter record, the Hessian FF7 L1 permit record, and the canonical OSM Colt London 4 record. The latter two are also the selected geometry evidence and must remain one immutable public evidence record each. No workload, role, or operating-model binding is added. The only promoted project metric is Colt London 4 planned 31 MW critical IT. Oracle campus-level planned 2,450 MW generation and AI workload and CyrusOne campus-level planned 81 MW critical IT remain unpromoted. Publisher identity, applicant identity, brand names, OSM operator tags, generator thermal input, transformer or utility MVA, and geometry metadata do not create owner, operator, user, tenant, customer, workload, operating-model, lifecycle, capacity, power, energy, efficiency, or imagery claims.

context_evidence_bindings.semantic_scope: The New Mexico State Ethics Commission record binds Acoma LLC, Project Jupiter, a data-center development, and Doña Ana County. It supports cross-source identity for the frozen named OSM campus locator only; it does not establish a legal boundary, current lifecycle, normalized role, project or campus capacity, generation installation or operation, workload, operating model, energy, efficiency, or imagery claim.

The Hessian permit record binds CyrusOne Frankfurt 7 Holdings B. V., FF7 L1, the Griesheim land-register district, listed parcels, and the official source coordinate. It supports identity and the selected project locator only; it is not a lifecycle observation, parcel or building boundary, current-work extent, normalized role, project capacity, operating model, workload, energy, efficiency, or imagery claim. Generator thermal input, transformer MVA, and utility-supply MVA are not data-center IT capacity.

The canonical OpenStreetMap way carries the exact distinctive name Colt London 4 and ref London 4. Those tags support identity for the selected building locator only. The OSM operator tag is not promoted to a normalized role, OSM supplies no authoritative lifecycle, and the geometry creates no official footprint, parcel, complete five-building campus extent, current-work extent, capacity, workload, operating model, energy, efficiency, or imagery claim.
